newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel mulls new Thomson offer - paper.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel mulls new Thomson offer - paper.

text.p: Alcatel-Alsthom may submit a new offer for Thomson SA if the planned sale of the French electronics group to Lagardere Groupe does not go through by the December 31 deadline, Liberation said on Tuesday.
On October 26 Alcatel chairman Serge Tchuruk was heard by the Gaullist deputy Patrick Devedjian, who has been looking into setting up a finance parliamentary committee on the Thomson privatisation.
In minutes obtained by Liberation, Tchuruk was quoted as saying he would "make a new offer that would take into account developments that have taken place since" his initial offer.
